intent: Admit the exact flat zero-valued web_search_requests and web_fetch_requests counters that Claude CLI 2.1.220 duplicates under result.model_usage.served_model_key, while preserving the bounded server_tool_use accounting rule. Treat only those two exact scalar false or numeric-zero names as non-authority; reject positive, true, string, collection, object, unknown, nested, and oversized values. The exception must be keyed to the two observed counter names and scalar-zero values without weakening rejection of web-search calls, inventories, or positive usage.
